title: Hearing on Parks Department budget and performance
summary: The Council will hold a budget and oversight hearing examining the Preliminary Budget for Fiscal Year 2027, the Preliminary Capital Plan for Fiscal Years 2027-2030 and the Fiscal 2026 Preliminary Mayor's Management Report as they relate to the Department of Parks and Recreation. The hearing is scheduled to begin at 11:30 a.m. with a public session following at 1:30 p.m.
